verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes a rendered OpenAPI 3.0 reference at api.secureframe.com/docs. It covers every tagged endpoint group with request/response schemas, embeds the full machine-readable spec, and documents a versioning policy. That makes the reference browsable and well-structured. However, nothing in the evidence shows a try-it console, runnable request examples, or code samples that can be executed from the reference. Missing for 10: evidence of runnable/try-it-out examples, evidence of interactive request execution in the reference, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
